question: Should OpenClaw adopt the narrow `openclaw commands` catalog, and which command identity, schema fields, plugin metadata, and Gateway/node relationships are stable commitments?
rationale: The linked implementation demonstrates feasibility, but only maintainers can authorize a durable public operator and plugin compatibility contract.

options.title: Adopt Narrow Catalog
options.body: Approve list and exact inspection with a minimal versioned schema and source-owned optional metadata.

options.title: Adopt Broader Catalog
options.body: Choose the wider `openclaw catalog` namespace and operational lenses before accepting a permanent contract.

options.title: Decline Shared Catalog
options.body: Improve CLI, Gateway, plugin, and node discovery independently without adding a normalized public inventory.

recommendation.title: Adopt Narrow Catalog
recommendation.body: Approve list and exact inspection with a minimal versioned schema and source-owned optional metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the repository's RFC acceptance lifecycle and are the strongest available owner for the required sponsorship decision.
